_contract: Terminal result of the bounded L40S certification of the device-resident state-eval reduction on the COMPLETE frozen suite. ENGINEERING evidence. It trains nothing, measures no behaviour, re-measures no frozen scientific checkpoint and AUTHORIZES NOTHING.
verdict: MEASURED — one predeclared requirement MET, one NOT MET, and the judgment returns to review
_why_not_PASS: the predeclared ABSOLUTE drift target on the ranked objectives was met (9.032e-06 < 1e-5, 11.1x below epsilon) and the real-candidate Pareto decisions were identical, but two of five epsilon-boundary cases changed a decision. Review's instruction was explicit: an exceeded target stops the run and the judgment comes back. The boundary construction is not re-engineered after seeing the result.

money._no_third_attempt: a third attempt would cost about as much again, crossing the soft work stop, and -- more decisively -- it would not be an engineering repair. What is unresolved is whether a 9.032e-06 absolute drift is acceptable against a 1e-4 epsilon, which is a review judgment, and re-running with a different boundary construction after seeing the outcome is precisely the move the authorization forbids.

suite._this_is_the_complete_frozen_suite: checked before any work: 80 items and 74,022 prediction positions or the run refuses. The four-item benchmark it supersedes covered 2032.

logits_were_identical.mechanism: a sha256 per distinct id sequence, recorded on first sight and checked on every later forward in any pass for any candidate
logits_were_identical._why_it_matters: the two implementations are compared across two passes. Without this the drift below could be the forward's rather than the reduction's.

ranked_objectives_ABSOLUTE_drift._the_drift_is_PROPORTIONAL_to_the_value: relative disagreement is ~1.7e-05 at every magnitude, so the ABSOLUTE drift tracks the metric. The worst figure, 9.032e-06, is at m=1.0 where worst_domain KL is 0.316; at m=0.05, where it is 0.0008, the drift is 1.4e-09. A real candidate's absolute drift therefore depends on how far that candidate sits from the teacher, and this certification bounds the coefficient rather than the number.

critical_token_metrics._the_rare_classes_are_covered: think_close and eos cover 70 positions each and tool_close 28, out of 74,022. These are the classes that decide termination and the ones the four-item benchmark contained none of. Their absolute drifts are 1.0e-08 and 5.1e-08 -- the largest relative disagreements in the run and the smallest absolute ones, because the values themselves are ~1e-07.

top1_agreement._exact: identical under both implementations, at every magnitude

diagnostics._the_large_relative_figure_is_not_a_find: 0.957 relative, on a metric whose own value is ~1e-05. Nothing prunes on diagnostics and dividing by a small number is not evidence; the absolute disagreement is 1.6e-05 nats on a pooled NLL of 2.58.

pareto_decisions._verified_both_ways: the stage asserted selected ids and front membership equal before the boundary cases ran, and the stored value sets reproduce it at $0.

wall_clock_complete_suite._the_76x_DOES_NOT_HOLD_on_the_complete_s: the four-item benchmark measured the new reduction at 0.0246 ms/position and reported 76.0x. On the complete suite the new reduction is 13.256 s over 74,022 positions = 0.179 ms/position, SEVEN TIMES slower per position, while the old path reproduces almost exactly (133.322 s = 1.80 ms/position against 1.8699 measured before). So the honest full-suite figures are 10.06x on the reduction and 2.63x on the whole state-eval pass. This is exactly the extrapolation review forbade, and it is why the conservative 1826.57-minute window was the right call: the planning estimate applied the 76x figure to the whole state_evaluation phase.
wall_clock_complete_suite._and_this_pass_is_not_an_expansion: an expansion forwards the 4B teacher AND a 596M student; this forwards the teacher once and perturbs its logits. 73.59 s of each pass is the forward. No new cost model is derived from these numbers and the ceiling is untouched.

what_did_not_pass.requirement: identical PARETO_V1 decisions on deliberately close cases straddling the epsilon boundary
what_did_not_pass._what_actually_happened: the two cases that changed are the two whose distance from the boundary is SMALLER than the measured drift: `at_epsilon` sits at 0 and `just_outside_epsilon` at 1.0e-07, against a drift of 9.032e-06. The three cases placed at or beyond the drift from the boundary all held, including both cases placed at exactly epsilon +/- the drift. So the flip region is narrower than the drift on each side.
what_did_not_pass._is_this_a_finding_about_the_optimizatio: NO, and that is the honest reading. ANY nonzero measurement disagreement flips a decision for a candidate pair whose gap lies within that disagreement of epsilon -- including the float32 noise of a single implementation against itself, which this project has never measured. The requirement as I implemented it was unsatisfiable: placing a pair 1e-07 outside a boundary and then applying a 9e-06 disagreement must cross it. `at_epsilon` is worse still -- at exactly the boundary the epsilon rule is decided by `>` versus `>=` on a difference that floating point does not represent exactly, so the clean pair already dominated.
what_did_not_pass._what_was_NOT_done_about_it: the construction was not re-engineered and the run was not repeated. Review's instruction was that an exceeded target stops the run, reports the measured values, and returns the judgment -- and rewriting a predeclared decision rule after seeing the outcome is the failure mode this project has already paid for twice.
what_did_not_pass.what_review_is_being_asked: whether a 9.032e-06 absolute drift is acceptable given a 1e-4 epsilon, knowing that it can only move a decision for candidates whose gap on a ranked objective lies within ~9% of epsilon of the boundary, that the real-candidate decisions were identical, and that the drift scales with the metric value rather than being a fixed offset.

subruns.failed_at: stage evaluate, the diagnostic relative-drift bound
subruns.cause: a diagnostic drifted 9.572e-01 RELATIVE, above a 1.859e-04 bound
subruns.root_cause: the bound was purely relative, and `nll_delta_vs_teacher_pooled` is a DIFFERENCE of two cross-entropies whose own value at the smallest perturbation is ~1e-05. A tiny absolute disagreement therefore reads as 96%. The message also did not name the metric, so the run reported a number nobody could act on.
repairs: the diagnostic bound is |drift| <= tol * max(|value|, 1.0) -- relative where there is a scale, absolute near zero -- and the message names every offending metric with its old and new values

--out defaults to the directory the launcher collects, and the report is written on every exit path. s1 measured all three candidates and wrote NOTHING: the launcher collected 0 files and $0.4925 of measurement survives only as a stdout tail
the candidate reuses the reference forward instead of forwarding the 4B teacher a second time -- four forwards per item per candidate became two
the forward is timed separately, so the REDUCTION wall time review asked for is isolated instead of mixed into the pass

_what_it_measured_anyway._identical_to_s2: the same figure to four significant digits on an independent pod, which is the only reproducibility evidence this certification has

subruns.cause: 2 of 5 boundary cases changed a decision under the measured drift -- see what_did_not_pass
subruns._everything_before_it_passed: the fingerprint stage, the full-suite evaluation of all three candidates, the predeclared absolute-drift target, the emitted-metric set, the critical-token position counts, the diagnostic bound and the real-candidate Pareto comparison
subruns._and_this_time_the_evidence_survived: one artifact collected, containing every per-metric, per-domain, per-subtype and per-tag drift for all three candidates -- which is what s1's repair was for

formal_c2_status_unchanged: the full joint search remains NOT AUTHORIZED, and its hard ceiling remains the conservative 1826.58-minute window. Nothing here re-prices anything.
